title: Ankhorage Graph
summary: Provides a canonical generic directed graph model, deterministic algorithms, and a provider-neutral persistence port.
purpose: Give packages reusable graph data, algorithms, and persistence contracts without coupling them to rendering, project detection, or provider APIs.
domain: directed graph data, algorithms, and persistence contracts
responsibilities: Define generic directed graph data and deterministic graph algorithms.
Define provider-neutral graph persistence contracts for compatible external consumers.
Expose graph operations through deliberate public entrypoints.
boundaries: Does not depend on Cytoscape, project detection, package managers, GitHub, dependency analysis, or rendering concerns.
Does not own application-specific graph semantics.
audience: Packages and applications that need portable directed graph data, algorithms, or persistence contracts.
useCases: Model and analyze directed graph relationships independently of a UI or provider.
Implement provider adapters against one portable persistence contract.

architecture.role: Portable directed-graph model, algorithm, and persistence-contract library.
invariants: The package remains independent of rendering and provider technology.
Persistence contracts never include provider clients, credentials, or query languages.

limitations: Application-specific graph meaning belongs to the consuming package.
